title: backlog.py answer refuses an answer that is none of the gate's options, naming them
goal: backlog.py answer ID GATE --answer TEXT exits 2 naming the options when the gate has options and TEXT is none of them, for every answerer, unless --free says a free answer is meant (gate g1), and leaves the gate unanswered, so a mistyped answer is not recorded as the operator's. Answers SP-evkj4avq, where an answer that reworded an option of ST-pvtfs43r's gate test-file was recorded and had to be answered again with the exact text.

run: import json,os,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.makedirs(t+"/_backlog"); open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json","w").write(json.dumps({"id":"ST-testtest","kind":"story","title":"t","status":"draft","goal":"g","touches":["x.md"]})); r=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",t,*a],capture_output=True,text=True); add=lambda g,q: r("gate","add","ST-testtest","--id",g,"--kind","provisional","--question",q,"--option","alpha","--option","beta","--recommendation","alpha"); gates=lambda: json.loads(open(t+"/_backlog/ST-testtest.json").read()).get("gates",[]); add("g9","which one?"); p=r("answer","ST-testtest","g9","--answer","gamma","--by","agent"); o=p.stderr+p.stdout; sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 and "alpha" in o and "beta" in o and "answer" not in gates()[0] else 1)

gates.question: Who may answer with a text that is none of the gate's options?
options: every answerer, with a --free flag that says a free answer is meant
only --by operator answers any text; an agent answers an option
gates.recommendation: every answerer, with a --free flag that says a free answer is meant
gates.answer: every answerer, with a --free flag that says a free answer is meant

notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 8 of 13, "Gates: commands, classing and host checks"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F2: a content sprint from the research queue lands on headless Sonnet workers. Premise run 2026-10-10 (plan SP-qxcj7fgy): answer ID g9 --answer gamma --by agent on a gate with options alpha and beta records gamma, exit 0: reproduces. (--provisional ignores --answer and takes the recommendation, so it is unaffected.) Consumers of the answer route read 2026-10-10: .claude/agents/kb-worker.md and .claude/skills/kb-item and kb-sprint use --provisional, --confirm or --answer approve (an option of the start gate) only: unchanged, in no touches. The exact-option rule is the story's; tests that answer a gate with another text (test_authority.py) are fixed in the story.
